tools.subtitle: API key management, Large Language Models (LLM), and prospecting services.

descriptions.geoapify: Find local businesses with name, address, phone, email, website and hours. 3,000 credits/day free (~90,000/mo). No credit card required. Multi-account auto-fallback.
descriptions.google-places: Find local businesses. Name, address, phone, rating, reviews, hours, website. $200/mo free per GCP project. Supports multiple projects with auto-fallback.
descriptions.yelp-fusion: Real reviews, ratings, business categories. 5,000 calls/day free per app. Supports multi-app auto-fallback.
descriptions.tavily: Web search + content extraction. 1,000 searches/mo free per account. Supports multi-account auto-fallback.
descriptions.firecrawl: Prospect website crawling. 500 free credits per account, then $16/mo Hobby. Multi-account auto-fallback.
descriptions.brave-search: Alternative privacy web search. 1,000 queries/mo free per subscription. Multi-sub auto-fallback.
descriptions.llama-local: Local GPU inference server (llama.cpp / llama-server on srvubuntu01). Ultra-fast, private, $0 cost. Dynamically detects model loaded in VRAM.
descriptions.gemini-pro: Cloud LLM for complex analysis. Supports multiple Pro accounts with auto-fallback when quota runs out.
descriptions.agent-reach: Social intelligence & web scraping engine without paid APIs ($0/mo). Reads Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube transcripts, Instagram, Facebook, and web articles to audit prospect digital footprint and capture leads.

scoring.digitalGapDesc: Lag in digital presence (web, social, chat, booking)

scoring.commercialStrategySubtitle: Prospect verdict & actionable closing directive for the sales partner
scoring.activeHotDesc: Business with high average ticket, high customer flow, and clear service gaps where they are losing sales daily.
scoring.activeHotAction: Visit in person today. Present the Pitch Deck and close the pilot on-site.
scoring.activeWarmHeadline: Qualified Lead with Clear Operational Pain Points
scoring.activeWarmDesc: Shows evident operational pain points (no 24/7 web chat or after-hours response). Prime candidate for core automations.
scoring.activeWarmAction: Send personalized WhatsApp message and schedule a 10-min live demo call.
scoring.activeNurtureDesc: Standard operation but ticket or urgency does not warrant immediate in-person visits.
scoring.activeNurtureAction: Add to WhatsApp/Email nurture sequence and re-evaluate next month.
scoring.activeSkipDesc: Very low ticket, low foot traffic, or insufficient volume to justify AI automations.
scoring.activeSkipAction: Do not waste time or gas on manual prospecting. Focus exclusively on HOT/WARM leads.
scoring.matrixHotDesc: High ticket + lead leaks. In-person visit today.
scoring.matrixWarmDesc: Clear digital gap. Immediate WhatsApp outreach.
scoring.matrixSkipDesc: No urgency or ticket. Skip from prospecting.
scoring.howToInterpretScore: How to interpret this Score for selling?

scoring.tierActionWarm: Solid candidate with clear automation opportunity.
scoring.tierActionWarmDo: 👉 Action: Contact immediately via WhatsApp or direct call.
scoring.tierActionNurture: Secondary opportunity or moderate ticket size.
scoring.tierActionNurtureDo: 👉 Action: Send pitch via WhatsApp/Email; low priority for in-person visit.
scoring.tierActionSkip: Low ticket business or no commercial urgency.
scoring.tierActionSkipDo: 👉 Action: Do not spend time or gas on in-person prospecting.
